name: Kumonomi Misora
source:
This Super Romanticist is the sole person to have acheived unaided flight.
Though her drawing skills have decreased, she continues striving to become a picture book writer.

[Translated from [url=http://cappuccino-soft.jp/lacryma-web/soranana/chara_misora.html]the official site[/url]].
[spoiler]Unknowingly became a Mahoutsukai after obtaining a "Wishgranting Magic Gemstone" (OOPArt) from [url=/c15171]Sagara Maiko[/url].[/spoiler]
